reading_issues: The JPEG has EXIF orientation=6, so viewers display it rotated 90 degrees; raw pixels are an upright chart and all measurements used them. Hardness bars and boundaries (30, 35, 60, 70, 90, 93 cm) measured from pixels. Two layers are trapezoids (0-30 cm: F base to F+ top; 60-70 cm: 4F base to 4F- top) with hardness_idx = mean and exact ties labelled with the upper label. The 30-35 cm glyph is a three-circle cluster with a secondary square; read as MF (clustered rounded grains, MFcl) with secondary FC. The top two table rows are stretched with leader lines to the 90 and 93 cm boundaries. CT11 SC at 70 cm sits on an FCxr/FCxr boundary (layer_grain FCxr); CT16 SC at 0 cm is at the ground in the DH (x2 is non-bold free text, count 2). Elevation, aspect, slope and coordinates are blank (SSV = Sunshine Village per the title).
